¿Qué pedidos están en mayor riesgo de in:
order_events
| where event_time >= ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(event_time, *) by order_id
| where isnotempty(order_id)
| where order_status !in ("completed", "cancelled")
| extend p = todynamic(payload)
| extend sla_remaining = todouble(p.sla_remaining)
| extend delay_score = iif(delay_minutes >= 10, 3, iif(delay_minutes >= 5, 2, 1))
| extend sla_score = iif(isnotnull(sla_remaining) and sla_remaining <= 5, 2, iif(isnotnull(sla_remaining) and sla_remaining <= 10, 1, 0))
| extend risk_score = delay_score + sla_score
| join kind=leftouter stations on station_id
| sort by risk_score desc, delay_minutes desc, sla_remaining asc
| take 20
| project event_time, order_id, channel, station_id, display_name, specialization, delay_minutes, sla_remaining, risk_score, order_status, severity
¿Qué estaciones están saturadas en este:
kitchen_events
| where event_time >= ago(30m)
| summarize arg_max(event_time, *) by station_id
| join kind=leftouter stations on station_id
| extend effective_capacity = iif(isnotnull(max_capacity), max_capacity, capacity)
| extend load_pct = iif(effective_capacity > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(queue_size) / todouble(effective_capacity), 1), real(null))
| extend drain_minutes = iif(queue_size > effective_capacity and avg_prep_minutes > 0, round(todouble(queue_size - effective_capacity) * avg_prep_minutes / todouble(effective_capacity), 1), real(0))
| where queue_size >= 5 or load_pct >= 100
| sort by load_pct desc, queue_size desc
| project event_time, station_id, display_name, specialization, station_status, queue_size, effective_capacity, load_pct, drain_minutes, avg_prep_minutes, severity
